newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow in Kansas on Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry moderate, demand fair.
Sales confirmed on 2,000 slaughter steers and 1,700 slaughter heifers Monday. For the week to date 12,200 head confirmed including 6,700 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 65.00.
